content_text: Thanks a lot Roger! I really love the elegance and simplicity of the cinematography of that movie, i think it’s perfect for the story without being too evident and attention demanding. As an exercise i’m storyboarding the dialogue between Meryl Streep and Viola Davis, one can learn a lot from that scene in terms of…well, everything, it’s perfect.
